# GENERATED by tools/gen_global_power.py - edit the generator, not this file.

# "No Diplomatic Standing" - both spirits that carry that name.
wif_gp_immune_spirit = {
	OR = {
		has_idea = wif_cw_no_diplomatic_standing
		has_idea = wif_splinter_no_factions
	}
}

wif_gp_is_global = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 4 } }
wif_gp_is_growing = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier = 3 } }
# Regional Power or Minor - the only sizes allowed to fight proxy wars.
wif_gp_is_proxy_size = { NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 1 } } }

# Global Powers, Growing Superpowers and No Diplomatic Standing are immune.
wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = {
	OR = {
		wif_gp_immune_spirit = yes
		check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 2 }
	}
}

wif_gp_eligible_global = {
	exists = yes
	is_subject = no
	has_capitulated = no
	has_tech = nukes
	has_tech = advanced_large_airframe
	wif_gp_immune_spirit = no
}

wif_gp_eligible_growing = {
	exists = yes
	is_subject = no
	has_capitulated = no
	has_tech = nukes
	is_faction_leader = yes
	wif_gp_immune_spirit = no
}

wif_gp_nuclear_power = {
	OR = {
		has_tech = nukes
		num_of_nukes > 0
	}
}

# A delivery system that is not sitting under fallout: a big air base plus a
# heavy airframe, or a rocket site plus a ballistic missile.
wif_gp_can_deliver = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			OR = {
				has_tech = basic_large_airframe
				has_tech = improved_large_airframe
				has_tech = advanced_large_airframe
			}
			any_controlled_state = {
				air_base > 2
				NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_fallout }
			}
		}
		AND = {
			OR = {
				is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_rockets_medium_range_ballistic_missile
				is_special_project_completed = sp:sp_rockets_long_range_ballistic_missile
			}
			any_controlled_state = {
				rocket_site > 0
				NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_fallout }
			}
		}
	}
}

# The faction of THIS has fewer than two Global Power picks this month.
wif_gp_faction_has_room = {
	OR = {
		is_in_faction = no
		NOT = {
			any_country = {
				is_faction_leader = yes
				OR = {
					tag = PREV
					is_in_faction_with = PREV
				}
				check_variable = { wif_gp_fac_picks > 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

wif_gp_nam_member = { has_idea = wif_gp_nam_member_idea }

wif_gp_nam_eligible = {
	exists = yes
	has_global_flag = wif_gp_atomic_age
	is_subject = no
	is_in_faction = no
	has_capitulated = no
	wif_gp_immune_spirit = no
	check_variable = { wif_gp_tier > 0 }
	check_variable = { wif_gp_tier < 3 }
	wif_gp_nam_member = no
	NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_1 > 39 } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_2 > 39 } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_3 > 39 } }
	NOT = { check_variable = { wif_gp_inf_4 > 39 } }
}

	}
}

# ROOT-scope decision helper: FROM's capital lies in a region ROOT claims.
wif_gp_from_in_root_claims = {
	OR = {
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_western_europe FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_western_europe = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_central_europe FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_central_europe = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_nordic FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_nordic = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_balkans FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_balkans = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_eastern_europe FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_eastern_europe = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_middle_east FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_middle_east = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_north_africa FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_north_africa = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_africa FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_africa = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_south_asia FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_south_asia = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_central_asia FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_central_asia = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_siberia FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_siberia = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_east_asia FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_east_asia = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_southeast_asia FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_southeast_asia = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_oceania FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_oceania = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_north_america FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_north_america = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_latin_america FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_latin_america = yes } }
		AND = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_claim_south_america FROM = { wif_gp_capital_in_south_america = yes } }
	}
}

# FROM may be targeted by ROOT's influence decisions.
wif_gp_valid_influence_target = {
	FROM = {
		exists = yes
		NOT = { tag = ROOT }
		is_subject = no
		wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
		NOT = { is_subject_of = ROOT }
	}
	wif_gp_from_in_root_claims = yes
}

# ROOT is FROM's patron (subject, faction leader or client).
wif_gp_root_is_from_patron = {
	FROM = {
		has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		var:wif_gp_patron = { tag = ROOT }
	}
}

# ROOT (slot 1) has FROM's patron as its rival.
wif_gp_from_in_rival_sphere_1 = {
	FROM = {
		has_country_flag = wif_gp_has_patron
		wif_gp_cannot_be_influenced = no
		var:wif_gp_patron = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_rival_of_1 }
	}
}

# Proxy wars ----------------------------------------------------------------
wif_gp_in_proxy = { check_variable = { wif_gp_px_id > 0 } }

# State scope: owned by a member of the winning side of proxy war cur_id.
wif_gp_on_win_side = {
	check_variable = { wif_gp_px_id = global.wif_gp_cur_id }
	check_variable = { wif_gp_px_side = global.wif_gp_win_side }
}

# State scope: a frontier state for border-first picking.
wif_gp_bfs_frontier = {
	NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_bfs }
	OR = {
		controller = { wif_gp_on_win_side = yes }
		any_neighbor_state = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_bfs }
		any_neighbor_state = { controller = { wif_gp_on_win_side = yes } }
		any_neighbor_state = { owner = { wif_gp_on_win_side = yes } }
	}
}

# Nuclear targets (state scope, ROOT = the nuking country) -------------------
wif_gp_nt_enemy = {
	controller = { has_war_with = ROOT }
	owner = { has_war_with = ROOT }
}
wif_gp_nt_mad = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	controller = { has_country_flag = wif_gp_mad_target_tmp }
}
wif_gp_nt_silo = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_fallout }
	rocket_site > 0
}
wif_gp_nt_airbase = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_fallout }
	air_base > 2
}
wif_gp_nt_industry = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	NOT = { has_state_flag = wif_gp_fallout }
	OR = {
		arms_factory > 2
		industrial_complex > 3
		dockyard > 2
	}
}
wif_gp_nt_city = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	OR = {
		is_capital = yes
		state_population_k > 1500
	}
}
wif_gp_nt_anything = {
	wif_gp_nt_enemy = yes
	OR = {
		is_capital = yes
		state_population_k > 500
		supply_node > 0
		rocket_site > 0
		air_base > 0
		arms_factory > 0
		industrial_complex > 0
	}
}
